O.content: The title reads "Preferred Mode of Transport in Region R".
A light-gray swatch is labeled "Public Transit".
The light-gray slice contains the printed inscription "58%".
The red slice contains the printed inscription "42%".
The routing criterion is visibly stated as "Majority-share transport mode" and the available option includes "Route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up".

B.text: If the legend binds the light-gray slice to Public Transit and the slice inscriptions are percentage shares, then the light-gray slice's printed 58% is Public Transit's share. A share above 50% is a majority share; for this task, the majority-share mode is routed to its matching majority-preference policy-follow-up option.
B.conditions: Applies to the two-slice Region R pie chart and assumes the printed slice percentages represent the transport-mode shares requested by the task.
